spec.title: Utilization
spec.description: Amount of time EPU or Tomo acquisition is running per day

spec.rawSql:
WITH all_durations AS (
  SELECT
    time::date AS day,
    'epu' AS source,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM running_duration) AS running_seconds
  FROM epu_running_daily
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
    AND instrument_id = $instrument

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    time::date AS day,
    'tomo' AS source,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM running_duration) AS running_seconds
  FROM tomo_running_daily
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
    AND instrument_id = $instrument
),

days AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    $__timeFrom()::date,
    $__timeTo()::date,
    interval '1 day'
  ) AS day
)

SELECT
  d.day AS time,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ad.source = 'epu' THEN ad.running_seconds END), 0) / 86400.0, 2) AS "EPU",
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ad.source = 'tomo' THEN ad.running_seconds END), 0) / 86400.0, 2) AS "Tomo"
FROM days d
LEFT JOIN all_durations ad ON ad.day = d.day
GROUP BY d.day
ORDER BY d.day;

SELECT
  SUM(ec.total_ts_counter) AS total_ts,
  ROUND(AVG(ec.total_ts_counter)) AS avg_ts_per_session,
  COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM SUM(er.running_duration)), 0) AS total_running_duration,
  SUM(ec.total_sm_counter) AS total_sm,
  
  -- terminated counts
  SUM(CASE WHEN er.has_terminated = TRUE  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS terminated_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN er.has_terminated = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count

FROM tomo_counters ec
JOIN tomo_sessions es
  ON es.session_id = ec.session_id
  AND es.start_time = ec.start_time
JOIN tomo_runs er
  ON er.session_id = ec.session_id
  AND er.start_time = ec.start_time
WHERE ec.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND es.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND er.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(es.start_time)

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_runs,
  COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM SUM(total_duration)), 0) AS total_duration
FROM epud_runs
WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(start_time)

spec.title: Beam time
spec.description: Beam time is based on the vacuum state of each instrument

spec.rawSql:
WITH daily_totals AS (
  SELECT
    day,
    SUM(seconds) AS total_seconds
  FROM vacuum_state_daily
  WHERE $__timeFilter(day)
    AND instrument_id = $instrument
  GROUP BY day
)
SELECT
  v.day AS "time",
  v.state,
  100.0 * SUM(v.seconds) / NULLIF(t.total_seconds, 0) AS percentage
FROM vacuum_state_daily v
JOIN daily_totals t
  ON v.day = t.day
WHERE $__timeFilter(v.day)
  AND v.instrument_id = $instrument
GROUP BY v.day, v.state, t.total_seconds
ORDER BY v.day, v.state;

SELECT
  AVG(daily_cartridge_count) AS "cartridges/day",
  SUM(daily_cartridge_count) AS "total cartridges",
  AVG(daily_cassette_count) AS "cassettes/day",
  SUM(daily_cassette_count) AS "total cassettes"
FROM load_counters_daily
WHERE $__timeFilter(day)
  AND instrument_id = $instrument

spec.title: Acquisitions
spec.description: Acquisitions are counted for both TFS and Gatan cameras. Data volume is only available for TFS cameras

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(daily_images)) AS "images/day",
  SUM(daily_images) AS "total images"
FROM image_counters_daily
WHERE $__timeFilter(day)
  AND instrument_id = $instrument

SELECT
  AVG(daily_terabytes) AS "data/day",
  SUM(daily_terabytes) AS "total data"
FROM data_counters_daily
WHERE $__timeFilter(day)
  AND instrument_id = $instrument

SELECT
  SUM(ec.total_image_counter) AS total_images,
  ROUND(AVG(ec.total_image_counter)) AS avg_images_per_session,
  COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM SUM(er.running_duration)), 0) AS total_running_duration,
  SUM(ec.skip_image_counter) AS total_skipped_images,

  -- terminated counts
  SUM(CASE WHEN er.has_terminated = TRUE  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS terminated_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN er.has_terminated = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count

FROM epu_counters ec
JOIN epu_sessions es
  ON es.session_id = ec.session_id
  AND es.start_time = ec.start_time
JOIN epu_runs er
  ON er.session_id = ec.session_id
  AND er.start_time = ec.start_time

WHERE ec.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND es.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND er.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(es.start_time)

spec.title: EPU acquisition speed
spec.description: Running duration is the actual automated acquisition run

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  ec.session_id AS "SessionID",
  es.start_time AS "Start time",
  es.end_time AS "End time",
  er.running_duration AS "Running duration",
  ec.total_image_counter AS "Total images",
  ec.skip_image_counter AS "Skipped images",
  CASE 
    WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM er.running_duration) > 0 THEN
      ec.total_image_counter / (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM er.running_duration) / 3600)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "Images/hour",
  er.has_terminated AS "Terminated"
FROM epu_counters ec
JOIN epu_sessions es
  ON es.session_id = ec.session_id
  AND es.start_time = ec.start_time
JOIN epu_runs er
  ON er.session_id = ec.session_id
  AND er.start_time = ec.start_time
WHERE ec.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND es.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND er.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(es.start_time)
ORDER BY es.start_time;

spec.title: Tomo acquisition speed
spec.description: Running duration is the actual automated acquisition run

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  ec.session_id AS "SessionID",
  es.start_time AS "Start time",
  es.end_time AS "End time",
  er.running_duration AS "Running duration",
  ec.total_image_counter AS "Total images",
  ec.total_ts_counter AS "Tilt series",
  CASE 
    WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM er.running_duration) > 0 THEN
      ec.total_image_counter / (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM er.running_duration) / 3600)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "Images/hour",
  CASE 
    WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM er.running_duration) > 0 THEN
      ec.total_ts_counter / (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM er.running_duration) / 3600)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "TS/hour",  
  ec.total_sm_counter AS "Search maps",
  er.has_terminated AS "Terminated"
FROM tomo_counters ec
JOIN tomo_sessions es
  ON es.session_id = ec.session_id
  AND es.start_time = ec.start_time
JOIN tomo_runs er
  ON er.session_id = ec.session_id
  AND er.start_time = ec.start_time
WHERE ec.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND es.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND er.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(es.start_time)
ORDER BY es.start_time;

spec.__legacyStringValue:

  id AS __value,
  name || ' [' || model || '] (' || serial || ')' AS __text
FROM instruments
WHERE is_active IS TRUE
ORDER BY name;
